Bi'an set: It comes with the unique spell Bi'an Flying Sword and the relic. The flying Sword can automatically fly out with the shot of active spell. Use the spacebar to trigger Sword-return and call back all the flying swords.

Use [[Sword of Judgement]] to defeat any leader to unlock the set.

This set is a crossover from Warm Snow.
